messages:
alex: Quick sync — ACME and BetaCorp asked for a smaller installer for private deploys so their netops can ship without touching IPAM. They want an installer that can be run in air-gapped mode and preserves existing routing + IP assignments.

sam: Clarify: do they want a fully offline package or just a slim by-default installer that skips optional networking modules?

maria: Field note: they want 'no cluster CIDR rewrites' and a way to opt out of our default NAT rules. Ideally a single flag. Also must not require kube-admin access.

alex: Exactly. Proposal: add --preserve-ips and --minimal-network flags to installer v0.9 that disable our overlay and leave host networking alone. Ship as opt-in.

jin: Concern: preserving IPs breaks our current tenant isolation assumptions. Need an operator mode that enforces per-tenant firewall hooks without reassigning IPs. Can we surface an operator config that maps external networks to internal tenant IDs?

sam: Implementation sketch: operator has two modes: isolated (current default) and passthrough (preserve-ips). In passthrough we deploy a lightweight shim that attaches conntrack and egress policy CRDs to pods. No CIDR rewrites.

alex: Good. Customer acceptance criteria: 1) installer runs in airgap, 2) no IP changes after upgrade, 3) revert path to isolated mode within 15min.

maria: Field tests to run: a) upgrade on an isolated prod cluster with BGP peering, b) offline installer on windows agents, c) tenant failover while preserving IPs. We can share two customer clusters for validation.

taylor: Security gating: passthrough mode must require an explicit admin consent + signed config. Also add KMS envelope for any operator secrets. Need checklist for compliance customers.

sam: Pseudocode for new CLI flags (for ops testing):
```
./installer --mode=airgap --slim=true --preserve-ips --operator-mode=passthrough
```
We should also have a validation step that warns if cluster network plugins are incompatible.

jin: Ops notes: we need to add a migration job that scans for overlapping subnets. If overlaps exist, fail fast with guidance. Also provide a rollback job that re-applies IP mappings.

alex: Prioritization ask: ship minimal network-preserve in next sprint as beta for existing customers, target GA in 3 sprints. Dependencies: operator feature flag, installer packaging changes, docs, field playbook.

maria: I'll coordinate customer test windows and provide sample configs. Also request a short runbook for netops to sign off.

sam: I'll draft the operator-mode PR and pain points doc. Will ping infra for packaging timeline.

ops-bot: deploy-checks: installer-package lint passed; airgap artifact build queued (job 7921).

alex: Next steps: sam to send RFC by EOD, taylor to prepare security checklist, maria to schedule two validation runs. We'll triage in planning on Thu. :calendar:
